posts.theme: Reel: Freedom, an extra hand whenever you need one (52 seconds)
posts.text:
Mom needs a little help this week, and you can't be in two places at once. 🧡

A Show-Me Neighbor can make a simple meal, wash the dishes, fold the laundry, take out the trash, pick up a prescription and sit down for a real conversation. Every Neighbor has a background check before they start.

posts.theme: Angle: priced like a house cleaner, does so much more
posts.headline: About what a house cleaner costs. So much more help.
posts.text:
Here is something most families don't expect: a Show-Me Neighbor costs about what you would pay a house cleaner. 🧺

But a Neighbor does a lot more than tidy up. In one visit, they can wash the dishes, fold the laundry, take out the trash, make a simple lunch, pick up a prescription, and sit down for a real conversation.

$34 an hour on weekdays. No contracts, ever.

{LINK}

posts.theme: Angle: one visit, the whole to-do list
posts.headline: One visit. The whole to-do list.
posts.text:
What could one visit from a Neighbor take off Mom's list? 📝

✔️ Dishes and light tidying
✔️ Laundry and fresh sheets on the bed
✔️ Taking out the trash
✔️ A simple meal, made together
✔️ Picking up a prescription
✔️ A grocery run
✔️ Watering the plants
✔️ Help with the phone, tablet or TV remote
✔️ Good company the whole time

One hour minimum, then billed by the 5 minutes.

{LINK}

posts.theme: Angle: prescription ready? So is your Neighbor.
posts.headline: Prescription ready? So is your Neighbor.
posts.text:
The pharmacy texted. The prescription is ready. And you are stuck at work until 6. 💊

A Show-Me Neighbor can pick it up, grab a few groceries on the way, and stay for a cup of coffee when they drop it off. Or drive Mom there herself, so she gets out of the house too.

Local and friendly, with a background check before they start. No contracts.

{LINK}

posts.theme: Angle: company coming for the holidays
posts.headline: Company coming for Christmas? Get Mom's house ready.
posts.text:
Family coming home for the holidays? 🎄

A Show-Me Neighbor can help Mom get ready: fresh sheets on the guest bed, a grocery run for the big dinner, the dishes, the laundry, and a trip to mail the cards.

(Neighbors skip ladders, so the roof lights are still on you.)

{LINK}

posts.theme: Angle: background checks before they start
posts.headline: Background checks before they start.
posts.text:
Before any Show-Me Neighbor rings Mom's doorbell: 🔒

✔️ A criminal background check across all 50 states
✔️ A driving record check
✔️ A live video interview with us
✔️ Our training course on being a good, safe visitor

And after every visit, you get a short note from your Neighbor.

You can feel comfortable with who is coming in.

{LINK}

posts.theme: Neighbor angle: already helping your own mom?
posts.headline: Already helping your own mom? Get paid to help someone else's.
posts.text:
If you already help your own mom with groceries, laundry and a ride to the doctor, you know how much it means. 💛

As a Show-Me Neighbor, you can get paid to do the same for an older adult near you. Pick your hours, stay close to home, and get paid after every visit.

No healthcare experience needed. Apply in about 5 minutes:
{LINK}

posts.theme: Angle: the sandwich generation
posts.headline: Raising kids and helping Mom? You need a Neighbor.
posts.text:
Soccer practice at 5. Mom's groceries. A work deadline. Dad's laundry. Sound familiar? 🥪

If you are caring for your kids and your parents at the same time, you are not alone, and you do not have to do every single thing yourself.

A Show-Me Neighbor can take a few things off your plate: errands, a simple meal, laundry, dishes and good company for Mom or Dad.

{LINK}

posts.theme: Angle: you can't leave work at 2pm
posts.headline: You can't leave work at 2. A Neighbor can be there.
posts.text:
Mom's appointment is at 2. Your meeting is at 2. 🚗

A Show-Me Neighbor can drive her there, wait with her, stop at the pharmacy on the way home, and send you a short note when the visit is done.

Book it from your phone in a few minutes, between meetings.

{LINK}

posts.theme: Angle: for grandkids worried about Grandma or Grandpa
posts.headline: Worried about Grandma living alone?
posts.text:
Worried about Grandma or Grandpa living on their own? 👵👴

A Show-Me Neighbor can stop by for company, a ride to the store, a simple meal, the laundry or a pharmacy run. You see who is coming before the visit and get a short note after.

Share this with your mom or dad. It might be just what the family needs.

{LINK}

posts.theme: Neighbor angle: good at dishes, laundry and conversation?
posts.headline: Good at dishes, laundry and a good conversation? That's the job.
posts.text:
Can you fold a load of laundry, make a simple lunch, drive to the pharmacy and keep a good conversation going? 🧺

Then you already have what it takes to be a Show-Me Neighbor. We are looking for friendly local people to help older adults with everyday things. Never personal care, never lifting.

Pick your hours and get paid after every visit.
{LINK}

posts.theme: Angle: Freedom, a network of helpers on your phone
posts.headline: Freedom: an extra hand for Mom, whenever you need one
posts.text:
Freedom looks like this. 🧡

Mom needs an extra hand this week, and you don't have to drop everything to be there.

Show-Me Neighbors is a network of friendly local helpers, each with a background check before they start, that you can book from your phone, for Mom, Dad, Grandma or Grandpa. Book one visit when something comes up, or set up a regular day. You see who is coming, and you get a short note after every visit.

posts.theme: Neighbor angle: you know your town
posts.headline: You know the back roads, the pharmacy and the best pie in town

posts.theme: Angle: when Dad is the one taking care of Mom
posts.headline: When Dad is the one taking care of Mom
posts.text:
When one parent takes care of the other, they rarely get a break. 💛

A Show-Me Neighbor can keep Mom company with cards and conversation while Dad gets a haircut, sees his own doctor, has lunch with friends, or just gets a few quiet hours for himself.

They can make a simple meal and do the dishes while they are there, too.

{LINK}

posts.theme: Angle: just need an hour?
posts.headline: Just need an hour? Book an hour.
posts.text:
Not every family needs help every day. Sometimes you just need an hour. ⏰

A load of laundry and the dishes. A prescription pickup. A quick grocery run and a chat on the porch.

Show-Me Neighbors visits start at one hour, then are billed by the 5 minutes. No contracts and no long-term schedule unless you want one.

{LINK}

posts.theme: Angle: getting back on their feet after a hospital stay
posts.headline: Home again, and the little things are piling up
posts.text:
After a hospital stay, the everyday things can pile up fast: groceries, prescriptions, dishes, laundry, the mail. 🏡

A Show-Me Neighbor can take care of those while Mom or Dad gets their strength back, and keep them company too.

(Neighbors give everyday help only: no personal or medical care, and no lifting.)

{LINK}

posts.theme: Neighbor angle: freedom for you too
posts.headline: Freedom for you, too. Your hours, your town, your call.
posts.text:
Freedom goes both ways. 🗝️

As a Show-Me Neighbor, you turn your hours on when you are free, see each visit offer and what you will earn before you say yes, and get paid after every visit.

Retirees, empty nesters, students and stay-at-home parents are all welcome. Background check and a friendly video interview required.

{LINK}

posts.theme: Angle: the best part of Grandpa's week
posts.headline: The best part of Grandpa's Tuesday
posts.text:
Some families book one visit. Others set up a regular day, and it becomes the best part of the week. ☕

Same friendly face, a walk around the block, the week's groceries, a load of laundry and the latest news from town.

When you mark a Neighbor as a favorite, they get your next visits first.

{LINK}

posts.theme: Angle: speaking to older adults themselves
posts.headline: Your home. Your way. A little help when you want it.
posts.text:
Want to keep living in your own home, your own way? 🏠

A Show-Me Neighbor is a friendly local person who can drive you to the store or the salon, pick up your prescriptions, help with the laundry and dishes, or just sit and visit for a while.

You decide when, and what would help. No contracts.

{LINK}
